maddeler.e:
أضمحل (form IVq)
# أَضْمَحِلُّ (ʔaḍmaḥillu) /ʔadˤ.ma.ħil.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
# أَضْمَحِلَّ (ʔaḍmaḥilla) /ʔadˤ.ma.ħil.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
# أَضْمَحِلِّ (ʔaḍmaḥilli) /ʔadˤ.ma.ħil.li/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِضْمَحَلَّ (iḍmaḥalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
